name: Fark

sources.title: FAQ: Submitting Links (search-indexed) — free account required; custom headline written by submitter; admins hand-pick a small % for the main page; all submissions are visible to TotalFark subscribers
Mobile submit page (search-indexed) — login required to submit links

conditions: Submission is free with a registered account, but admins hand-pick a small percentage of links for the main page — there is no guaranteed placement
All submissions appear in the TotalFark (paid subscriber) queue view regardless of approval
Fark is a funny/weird news aggregator — the link must be genuinely newsworthy or amusing with a witty custom headline; a SaaS launch announcement will almost never qualify
requirements: Registered Fark account (email confirmation required before submitting)
A link that fits Fark's editorial mix: weird, funny, or notable news — not product promotion
A custom headline written by the submitter — the headline IS the listing
preparation: A genuinely newsworthy/amusing link (e.g. odd press coverage), plus a Fark-style witty headline
Review Fark's posting rules before submitting
workflow: Register and confirm an account at fark.com (site 403s automated fetches — use a browser)
Click 'Submit a Link' and enter the URL plus the custom headline and a tag/category
Submissions go to the queue visible to TotalFark subscribers; admins pick a small % for the public main page
Resubmissions of rejected links with better headlines are a normal part of the culture
watchFor: Not a startup directory — a self-promotional product URL has near-zero approval odds and can flag the account
You don't need a paid TotalFark subscription to get approved, but paid users see all submissions
Link exposure is the linked story itself — Fark main-page links go to the external URL
Email confirmation is required before the submit form works
countsAsLive: The submitted link with its custom headline appears on the Fark main page or a category page (admins' pick); weaker proof: visible in the TotalFark submissions queue
unknowns: Whether main-page outbound links are follow/nofollow
Account-age or karma requirements beyond email confirmation
